You can now work with GitHub Copilot directly in Xcode’s built-in coding assistant, bringing Copilot into your native Xcode workflow. The integration is now in public preview, available starting with…
You can now work with GitHub Copilot directly in Xcode’s built-in coding assistant , bringing Copilot into your native Xcode workflow. The integration is now in public preview, available starting with Xcode 27.3 beta.
This gives you another way to use Copilot in Xcode. The existing GitHub Copilot f
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub Copilot 现已以 public preview 形式接入 Xcode 27.3 beta 的内置 coding assistant，需 macOS Tahoe 26.6 及以上，在 Settings > Intelligence 中配置，所有 Copilot 套餐均支持，原 Xcode 扩展仍保留。

en.reason: GitHub Copilot is now in public preview inside Xcode 27.3 beta’s built-in coding assistant, requiring macOS Tahoe 26.6 or later and setup via Settings > Intelligence, with all Copilot plans supported and the original Xcode extension retained.

sources.title_original: ChatGPT can now turn text prompts and photos into animated GIFs with OpenAI's Images 2.6 model
sources.summary:
OpenAI is adding a GIF feature to ChatGPT. With the new Images 2.6 model, users can create animated GIFs from text prompts or photos and then adjust speed and individual frames. The model's image consistency is strong enough to keep characters recognizable across frames, making flipbook-style animation possible. en.title: One person running a company with hundreds of AI Agents—this is what the independent developer workstation looks like now.
en.summary:
A single person running a company with hundreds of AI Agents — this is what the indie developer's desk looks like now.

Developer @EHuanglu's one-man battle log:
• Dozens of terminals packed across the screen, with hundreds of Agents running code, testing features, scraping data and handling operations in parallel in the background;
• The human doesn't write the grunt-work code, just sits at the top-level dashboard as CEO, reviewing summaries and clicking confirm;
• Software, hardware and phone monitoring all wired together — one person is a fully staffed digital outsourcing team.

Building a product used to mean hiring a group of people. Now it comes down to how many high-IQ agents one person can command at the same time.

📎 Video from @EHuanglu

#AIAgent #OnePersonCompany #SuperIndividual #IndieDev #AI

en.title: One person running a company with hundreds of AI Agents—this is what the independent developer workstation looks like now.
en.summary:
A single person running a company with hundreds of AI Agents — this is what the indie developer's desk looks like now.

Developer @EHuanglu's one-man battle log:
• Dozens of terminals packed across the screen, with hundreds of Agents running code, testing features, scraping data and handling operations in parallel in the background;
• The human doesn't write the grunt-work code, just sits at the top-level dashboard as CEO, reviewing summaries and clicking confirm;
• Software, hardware and phone monitoring all wired together — one person is a fully staffed digital outsourcing team.

Building a product used to mean hiring a group of people. Now it comes down to how many high-IQ agents one person can command at the same time.

📎 Video from @EHuanglu

en.title:
AI Is Running Faster and Faster—Who Holds the Emergency Stop?
You still hold control: the AI emergency stop is here—first, see what it can cut off. On November 3 at Fal.Con Europe in Barcelona, CrowdStrike put the AI emergency stop on the launch stage.
en.summary:
AI Is Running Faster and Faster. Who Holds the Emergency Stop?

“You Still Hold Control”: AI Kill Switch Goes Live—First, See What It Can Cut Off

On November 3 at Fal.Con Europe in Barcelona, CrowdStrike unveiled its AI kill switch. Founder and CEO George Kurtz said in the announcement that deploying agents with a kill switch means you still hold control. The scenario is easy to imagine: an agent with enterprise permissions keeps calling tools, then at some step suddenly deviates from the task. Admins need to hit stop before investigation can catch up. According to Security Boulevard that day, the new feature first blocks agents from accessing models through a connected AI gateway. CrowdStrike’s technical blog also lists broader controls, such as directly terminating endpoint processes and preventing restarts, as future extensions. That means, as you read…
en.reason: CrowdStrike unveiled an AI kill switch at its Fal.Con Europe conference in Barcelona on November 3, initially blocking agent access to models through a connected AI gateway, with terminating endpoint processes and preventing restarts listed as later extensions.

en.title: The most lucrative AI startup opportunities in 2027
en.summary: AI can churn out content at scale, yet many accounts end up sounding more and more alike: exposure without trust, topics without customers. The problem is often that they focus only on posting, without ever thinking through "why this person is worth following long-term." Doe Koe's latest article is worth a close read for creators.

sources.title_original: Codex改了又测、测了又改，我一查Token才发现这个坑
sources.summary: 让 Codex 修个小问题，它却“改—全量测—再改”。跑上半天，额度和耐心一起见底；更糟的是，一堆测试通过，真正点运行还是报错。作者给出一套可直接塞进 AGENTS.md 的收口办法。常用Codex、Claude Code却总被“自我循环”拖慢的人，可以照着改一次规则试一试。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者让 Codex 反复改代码再测试，结果发现反复分析和修改吃掉大量 Token，还举了已通过237272个测试、一运行却 Error xxx 无法启动的例子，并翻讨论看别人是否也遇到简单任务被塞满测试。

en.title: Codex edited then tested, tested then edited again—I only spotted the trap when I checked the Tokens
en.summary: Ask Codex to fix one small issue, and it cycles through edit, full test run, edit again. Half a day disappears, and your quota and patience hit bottom together. Worse: a pile of tests pass, but hitting run still throws an error. The author offers a set of guardrails you can drop straight into AGENTS.md. If you use Codex or Claude Code regularly and keep getting slowed down by these self-loops, it's worth adjusting your rules once and giving it a try.
en.reason: Codex can burn through tokens by repeatedly editing and running full test suites, as shown by a case where 237,272 tests passed yet the app failed to start with Error xxx, with AGENTS.md rules offered to stop that loop.

sources.title_original: 研究发现：AI 生成代码受下游环节瓶颈制约，无法提升整体生产力
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 哈佛大学联合 Jellyfish 调研 718 家企业发现，AI 智能体虽让代码行数增加 30%，但 Jira 工单解决量仅增 12%，合并请求平均评审时长增加 49%、评论数增加 53%，瓶颈转移到了下游评审环节。

en.title: Study: AI-generated code hits downstream bottlenecks and fails to boost overall productivity
en.reason: Harvard and Jellyfish's survey of 718 firms finds AI agents raise code volume 30% but Jira ticket resolutions only 12%, with review time up 49% and comments up 53%, shifting the bottleneck downstream.

stories.title: 传统金融体系的清算节奏，始终锚定着人类的工作边界。T+1、T+3 的结算规则，是人工审核、跨机构对账、风控复核以及非全天候运营模式共同塑造的产物。在以人为交易主体的商业环境中，资金的延时沉淀，长期被行业视作正常的运转代价。 AI 驱动的机器经济正在打破这套时间框架。在机器的价值标尺里，资金的每一秒静止，都意味着资本利用效率的流失。 如今行业热议 AI Agent，关注点大多聚焦于模型推理效能、交易策略的精巧度与自主决策能力。大家热衷于…

sources.title_original: 如何把目标定得更大胆：写给 AI 使用者的实践指南
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Claude 开发者 Felix Rieseberg 在指南中主张用 AI 从速度、高度、深度、广度四维抬高目标，例如把逐个修复崩溃升级为让应用不再崩溃。

en.title: How to set bolder goals: a practical guide for AI users
en.reason: Claude developer Felix Rieseberg's guide argues AI users should raise ambitions across speed, height, depth and breadth—turning “fix each crash” into “make the app stop crashing”—rather than merely optimizing prompts for faster tasks.

en.title: DeepSeek's Super-agent design and our engineering practice
en.summary: The author uses LobeHub to reflect on the shift from stacking up roles to keeping tasks continuously moving—a useful reference for developers building Agent teams.
en.reason: LobeHub's engineering retrospective explains DeepSeek Harness's Super-agent design, where multiple Workers run in parallel with separate contexts, messages reach Workers via subscription channels instead of routing through the Router, session state lives in a database, and an external Watchdog monitors failures and progress.

stories.title: 今年听过最好的 AI Native 思考，真诚又足够接地气。

sources.title: 今年听过最好的 AI Native 思考，真诚又足够接地气。
sources.title_zh: 今年听过最好的 AI Native 思考，真诚又足够接地气。
sources.title_original: 今年听过最好的 AI Native 思考，真诚又足够接地气。
sources.summary: 作者这篇笔记梳理了快手企业 AI 落地经验，给出了一个可落地的解法：先沉淀员工经验为共享能力，再重构分工；以小团队模式压缩交付链路，搭配需求风险分级的智能质检体系，同时搭建统一底座与积分机制管控成本。这套兼顾试点试错和企业治理的思路，可以帮大小团队避开 Agent 孤岛、空转、质量失控等问题。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 快手沈浪将企业AI生产力实践概括为研发提效、更多员工、团队AI、组织AI四阶段，并指出AI Coding下一步要重设计软件交付流程、沉淀经验资产、统一基础设施，值得参考。

en.title: The best take on AI Native thinking I've heard this year—sincere and refreshingly down-to-earth.
en.summary: The author's notes distill Kuaishou's enterprise AI deployment experience into a practical playbook: first codify employee expertise into shared capabilities, then restructure how work is divided; use small teams to shorten delivery chains, pair that with an intelligent QA system that grades requirements by risk, and build a unified foundation plus a credit/points mechanism to control costs. This approach balances pilot experimentation with enterprise governance, helping teams of all sizes avoid Agent silos, idle spinning, and quality loss of control.
en.reason: Kuaishou’s Shen Lang maps enterprise AI productivity across four stages—R&D efficiency, more employees, team AI and organizational AI—and says AI Coding must next redesign software delivery, turn staff experience into shared assets and unify infrastructure.

stories.title: 开源我这折腾了1年的「Agent自动化系统」，愿所有人都能感受Agent的魅力。

sources.title: 开源我这折腾了1年的「Agent自动化系统」，愿所有人都能感受Agent的魅力。
sources.title_zh: 开源我这折腾了1年的「Agent自动化系统」，愿所有人都能感受Agent的魅力。
sources.title_original: 开源我这折腾了1年的「Agent自动化系统」，愿所有人都能感受Agent的魅力。
sources.summary: 卡兹克将自用的Agent自动化系统重构后，开源了Agent-Autoloop。整套架构采用插件化设计，事件、模型、通知通道均可自由接入，适配绝大多数主流Agent。文中还展示了大量可直接复用的自动化场景，个人和团队都能快速搭建自主流转、按需人工审批的智能工作流。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 折腾1年的Agent自动化系统开源为Agent-Autoloop，借鉴Pi与DeepSeek Harness插件化理念，花两天重写，除内核外全做成可热插拔插件。

en.title: After a year of tinkering, I'm open-sourcing my Agent automation system — I hope everyone gets to experience the magic of Agents.
en.summary: Kazik has open-sourced Agent-Autoloop after rebuilding the Agent automation system he uses himself. The architecture is plugin-based throughout: events, models, and notification channels can all be plugged in freely, and it works with most mainstream Agents. The article also showcases a large set of directly reusable automation scenarios, so individuals and teams can quickly build intelligent workflows that run autonomously and call for human approval on demand.
en.reason: Kazike open-sourced Agent-Autoloop, a year-long agent automation system rebuilt in two days drawing on Pi and DeepSeek Harness's plugin approach, making everything but the kernel a hot-swappable plugin for events, models and notifications, plus reusable approval workflows.

stories.title: 让用户放心信任自己的 MCP 客户端，同时不给钓鱼攻击留可乘之机 / Letting users trust their own MCP clients, without opening a phishing hole

sources.title: 让用户放心信任自己的 MCP 客户端，同时不给钓鱼攻击留可乘之机 / Letting users trust their own MCP clients, without opening a phishing hole
sources.title_zh: 让用户放心信任自己的 MCP 客户端，同时不给钓鱼攻击留可乘之机
sources.title_en: Letting users trust their own MCP clients, without opening a phishing hole
sources.title_original: Letting users trust their own MCP clients, without opening a phishing hole
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章揭示MCP服务器对自定义客户端要么拒绝、要么开放钓鱼漏洞的两难：2026年5月测试119个OAuth MCP服务器，114个（95.8%）注册端点接受任意redirect_uri；并提出登录时按用户决定可信redirect URI。

en.reason: In a May 2026 test of 119 OAuth MCP servers, 114 (95.8%) registration endpoints accepted arbitrary redirect_uris, and Alexander Loginov proposes per-user trusted redirect URIs decided at sign-in to let custom MCP clients connect without opening a phishing hole.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这本紧凑的推导式入门书把 PCA、diffusion models 与 GANs 等生成模型串成一条数学主线，帮助研究者理解这些模型如何推导、彼此关联，适合想打牢基础的人。

en.reason: A compact, derivation-oriented primer traces a single mathematical thread from PCA, probabilistic PCA and variational autoencoders through diffusion models, normalising flows and autoregressive factorisations to GANs, Wasserstein GANs and energy-based models.

sources.summary:
An LLM-powered agent for Datasette
3rd November 2026
This is a significant release of Datasette Agent . The most notable new feature is called the panel - it lets the agent chat open and then sit next to pages from Datasette, for example a table or query page.
When combined with datasette-apps this means you can prompt a database-backed app into existence and then modify it from the chat that sits next to that app.
You can try it by signing in with your GitHub account to agent.datasette.io .
Thi
sources.recommend_reason_zh: datasette-agent 0.5a0的panel可让聊天窗口与Datasette表或查询页并排，并配合datasette-apps用提示生成数据库应用。

en.reason: datasette-agent 0.5a0 introduces a panel that places the agent chat beside Datasette table or query pages, and with datasette-apps lets users prompt a database-backed app into existence and modify it from that adjacent chat.
